lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Was that me? That was me.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: Want me to hold that for you?

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: BEHIND US! WHY IS IT ALWAYS BEHIND US?

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: IT'S BEHIND US! I SAID THIS!

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Some doors open to faith, my son. Not to swinging.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Fire. Against rot. Truly, a scholar.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: It ATE it. The wall ate my fireball.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: It's alive. I don't like stabbing things that are alive.

lines.speaker: fighter
lines.text: Don't look at me. You do the praying.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: It resists. The Light is patient.

lines.speaker: fighter
lines.text: Tastes like the floor. Still good.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: You didn't have the faith, my son.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light does not protect those who pick its pockets.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: All that reading, and not one prayer.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Is {actor} meant to be that colour?

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Who prays now? Does anyone know how?

reply.speaker: fighter
reply.text: I'm hungry. Someone get a fire on.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light brought you back, my son.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light brought you back, my child.

reply.speaker: thief
reply.text: That was a scroll. Ask the scroll.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light brought you back, my child.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: I was at peace. There was light.

reply.speaker: cleric
reply.text: And you dragged me back here for this?

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: I forgive you for taking so long.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: I was dead. I have so many questions.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: My god is not a well you can keep drawing from.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light needs a moment. So do I.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Even devotion has a limit. Mine is high.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Pray, my child. It costs nothing.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: I'm out of mana. This is how I die.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: I'm empty. Nobody tell the monsters.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: Out of magic? Try a knife, {actor}.

lines.speaker: fighter
lines.text: No spells? Fine. Stand behind me.

reply.speaker: thief
reply.text: Then it can carry the bags.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Don't thank me. I'm not carrying it.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Such burdens the faithful must bear.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: I'd have found it sooner alone.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: I read that everything here is cursed.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light showed the way. Through me.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Naturally. The Light does the hard parts.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: You may thank me later. Or now.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: Easy. Don't ask how I knew.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: The Light would have asked nicely.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Structurally, that was a bad idea.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: Observe: not a scratch on me.

lines.speaker: thief
lines.text: I'll check their pockets. For safety.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Is it dead? Check it's dead.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: I counted six ways that went wrong.

lines.speaker: cleric
lines.text: You're not so bad with a sword.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: It worked! It actually... ahem. As expected.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: Of course it resisted. Of course.

lines.speaker: mage
lines.text: It's moving again. It's moving again.
